title: Bleach Extraction Protocol for DNA Recovery from Bone or Tooth Powder
author: Valeria Mattiangeli
materials: Briefly vortex to ensure the powder enters solution, then incubate on a thermomixer 900 rpm, 37 °C, 30 minutes (or rotor speed 20 using H2020plus Incubated tube rotator from Benchmark Scientific). At 10 minute intervals, pause the thermomixer and briefly vortex each sample tube (not required if on rotor).
To labeled Roche column reservoirs, add 13 mL of modified PB buffer.

steps.title: Prepare reagents and consumables
steps.instruction: UV‑irradiate n × 3 mL laboratory‑grade water and n × 1 mL 0.5 M EDTA for 30 min; prepare extraction buffer (per tube: 17 µL N‑Laurylsarcosine, 20 µL 1 M Tris‑HCl, 940 µL 0.5 M EDTA, add 13 µL proteinase K after UV‑treating buffer for 30 min); prepare modified PB binding buffer (per tube: 0.42 mL 3 M sodium acetate, 0.33 mL 5 M sodium chloride, 12.25 mL Qiagen PB buffer) to 13 mL total and verify pH 5–5.5 with a strip (adjust acetate/chloride if needed); label Roche High Pure Extender Assembly spin columns (Roche Cat #05114403001) one per sample; aliquot 80–120 mg bone/tooth powder into 2 mL Eppendorf tubes (max 16 samples + controls per batch) and add one empty tube as extraction control; heat EBT (50 µL × n + 1) to 65 °C in a thermomixer.

steps.title: First bleach extraction
steps.instruction: Add 990 µL of 0.5 % (v/v) sodium hypochlorite to each tube, vortex briefly, then incubate at room temperature for 15 min on a rotator (H2020plus Incubated tube rotator, speed 35) or in a thermomixer at 900 rpm; centrifuge at maximum speed (≈17000 × g, 13300 rpm) until pellet forms and discard supernatant without disturbing the pellet.

steps.title: Three water washes
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL pre‑UV‑treated laboratory water to each tube, vortex to resuspend pellet, centrifuge at maximum speed (≈17000 × g, 13300 rpm) and discard supernatant; repeat water addition, vortex, centrifuge, discard supernatant two additional times (total three washes).

steps.title: UV‑EDTA extraction
steps.instruction: Add 990 µL UV‑treated 0.5 M EDTA to each tube, centrifuge at maximum speed (≈17000 × g, 13300 rpm), carefully transfer the supernatant to a new tube labeled “sample‑BEDTAx” (x = extraction number) and freeze the BEDTA tubes for optional later use.

steps.title: Optional BEDTA DNA recovery
steps.instruction: To each frozen BEDTA tube add the remaining components of the extraction buffer (see Step 1) directly to the EDTA, incubate at 37 °C, 900 rpm for 1 day, then continue with Extraction Day 2 steps.

steps.title: Proteinase digestion (Day 2)
steps.instruction: Add 990 mL of extraction buffer containing proteinase K to each tube, cover with parafilm and vortex until the bone pellet is completely in solution; incubate overnight (15–24 h) at 37 °C, 900 rpm (or on H2020plus rotator at speed 18).

steps.title: Post‑digestion spin
steps.instruction: Centrifuge tubes for 10 min at maximum speed (13300 rpm, ≈17000 × g).

steps.title: Transfer supernatant to columns
steps.instruction: Pipette 1 mL cleared supernatant from each tube onto the corresponding labeled Roche High Pure Extender Assembly column, avoiding any bone powder carry‑over.

steps.title: First column spin
steps.instruction: Spin the column at 700 × g for 2 min in a swing‑bucket rotor (50 mL tubes), rotate the tube 90°, then spin again for 2 min at 700 × g (speed may be reduced to 600 g).

steps.title: Remove reservoir and dry‑spin
steps.instruction: Detach the extension reservoir (silica filter) from the Falcon tube into a clean collection tube, discard side flaps and snap tabs; dry‑spin the collection column at 3000 × g for 1 min (≈6000 rpm).

steps.title: PE buffer washes
steps.instruction: Add 750 µL Qiagen PE buffer (Cat #19065) to each column, spin at 3000 × g for 1 min and discard flow‑through; repeat the PE wash once more (total two washes).

steps.title: Final dry‑spin and elution prep
steps.instruction: Dry‑spin columns again at 3000 × g for 1 min, then place each column into a fresh 1.5 mL labeled Eppendorf tube (label format “sample‑MBEXx”, x = bleach extraction number).

steps.title: Elution of DNA
steps.instruction: Add 25 µL EBT to the filter, incubate 2 min, then spin at maximum speed (13300 rpm, ≈17000 × g); repeat once more for a total elution volume of 50 µL.

steps.title: Store purified DNA
steps.instruction: Store the final DNA eluate tubes at –20 °C.

steps.title: Handle residual pellet
steps.instruction: Freeze any remaining pellet or, if desired, perform a second extraction starting from the extraction buffer addition (Step 6).

steps.title: Final column check
steps.instruction: Verify that no liquid remains on the column; if liquid is present, spin an additional minute.
